itemized.notes: 4-page standard form: p1 cover ('Seven days before a general election' box checked; NEITHER amendment box ticked; Steven L. DeBry, Republican, County Council #5; signed 10-25-10, clerk-stamped OCT 26 2010), p2 Summary Page, p3 Schedule A (10 rows), p4 Schedule B (5 rows). PER-FILER SCHEDULE SEMANTIC (the DeBry pattern already known in this corpus): SUBTOTAL FOR THIS PAGE = this reporting period, TOTAL = cycle-to-date, so the two legitimately disagree on both schedules. The stated totals from the Summary Page match the SUBTOTALs exactly. REDACTION: the mailing-address cells of the four INDIVIDUAL contributors (rows 2, 3, 8, 9) are covered by solid white blocks on the scan - a county redaction of residential addresses, marked 'redacted' in those rows. The six organizational contributors' addresses are printed; their street lines were discarded at read time and only city/state recorded (privacy). Cents are written as a superscript over a rule throughout ('$400 00'); transcribed with a decimal point.
